title: Maize Growing Tips for Sustainable Production 1

subtasks.task_text: Describe the process of selecting and purchasing maize seeds.
subtasks.text: Consult with extension officers to choose the best maize variety for your area.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the process of selecting and purchasing maize seeds.
subtasks.text: Purchase certified seeds from the AgroDealer recommended by the Agri Business Hubs.

subtasks.task_text: Explain how to determine the appropriate planting time based on rainfall patterns.
subtasks.text: Plant late maturity varieties in regions with high rainfall during the early part of the rainy season.

subtasks.task_text: Explain how to determine the appropriate planting time based on rainfall patterns.
subtasks.text: Plant medium maturity varieties in the middle of the rainy season.

subtasks.task_text: Explain how to determine the appropriate planting time based on rainfall patterns.
subtasks.text: Plant early maturity varieties towards the end of the rainy season.

subtasks.task_text: Discuss soil management practices for sustainable maize production.
subtasks.text: Ensure soil testing every 3 to 4 years for soil acidity and magnesium.

subtasks.task_text: Discuss soil management practices for sustainable maize production.
subtasks.text: Apply lime to maintain a soil pH between 5.5 and 7 before planting.

subtasks.task_text: Outline principles of maize planting and fertilization.
subtasks.text: Plan for 4 to 5 plants per square meter in areas with good rainfall and fertile soils.

subtasks.task_text: Outline principles of maize planting and fertilization.
subtasks.text: Aim for 3 to 4 plants per square meter in areas with low rainfall or limited nutrients.
